title: Princess Maani
description: Princess Maani is a 41 m, 14-cabin liveaboard for 28 guests, featuring two jacuzzis, a sun deck and an open-air cocktail bar. A dedicated dive dhoni and free Nitrox keep diving seamless, while a European-chef kitchen, kayaks/SUP and massage elevate your surface time.

title: Sachika
description: Sachika is an award-winning Maldivian dive safari yacht, combining adventure and elegance. With spacious cabins, a jacuzzi sundeck, and a dedicated dive dhoni, she offers seamless comfort and world-class diving with mantas, sharks, and whale sharks across the atolls.
